title: Flying Lotus attends the tridactyl unveiling presentation
place_text: Los Angeles area (near Flying Lotus's home)

tellings.quote: Um well, they didn't have them there. There was a presentation like saying that they are, you know, they were showing the photos and the the X-rays and all that stuff.

plain: The hip hop artist Flying Lotus says he went to a presentation near his home in the Los Angeles area about the "tridactyls", three-fingered bodies shown as possibly not human. He tells Michels the bodies were not actually there: "they were showing the photos and the X-rays and all that stuff," and he names Jaime Maussan in connection with it.
